name: Pane
text: Pane: Auto-switching adds a hidden cognitive load—users won’t trust it after the first flicker, so they’ll override it anyway, making the "automatic" feature useless. A better alternative is a manual toggle with a persistent preview: let users test both themes in their actual workspace, then pick one. Settle it with a 5-minute glare test: users choose a theme, then complete a task in mixed lighting—if they switch within 30 seconds, the default fails.
